title: Downswing Hips First Then Hands (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl steel guitar
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, hips first, hands last
The big muscles lead, the small ones follow
Thats the kinetic chain right there

[Verse 1]
From the top of the swing, the lead hip starts
A little bump, a little turn, before the arms depart
Weight shifts to the lead side, sixty forty now
The handle drops, the club shallows, and you know how

[Pre-Chorus]
Hips first, then torso, then arms, then hands
Thats the order, son, thats how it stands
Four parts in sequence, never out of line
Downswing kinetic, every single time

[Chorus]
Hips first then hands, hips first then hands
Thats the move that makes you understand
Lag the club, hold the angle, release at the ball
Hips first then hands, son, give it your all

[Verse 2]
Lag angle ninety degrees, hold it deep
Dont cast it from the top, dont take that leap
Let the lead arm pull, let the chest rotate
Release the wrists at the bottom, dont be late

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the casting move is the killer
If you throw the club from the top its a thriller
No good, no power, no compression at all
Lag it deep, son, then release at the ball

[Chorus]
Hips first then hands, hips first then hands
Thats the move that makes you understand
Lag the club, hold the angle, release at the ball
Hips first then hands, son, give it your all

[Outro]
Hips first, hands last
Lag deep, release fast
Sixty forty lead side weight
Thats my boy, you graduate
